title: 2 soldiers wounded in Oriental Mindoro clash with suspected NPA combatants
summary: Two soldiers were wounded in an armed encounter with suspected members of the New People’s Army (NPA) in Sitio Gatol, Barangay San Roque, Bulalacao, Oriental Mindoro, on Monday morning.
